title: Board reforms and M&A performance: international evidence

rival_explanations: acquirer-country board reforms (rather than target-country reforms) drive the results
common-law countries with more developed capital markets drive the results

context.industry_setting: cross-industry (M&A deals across all sectors, excluding financial targets with SIC codes 6000-6999)
context.country_region: international; board reforms across 61 countries, with domestic and cross-border M&A deals involving acquirers and targets from those 61 sample countries
context.sample_description: M&A transactions from the Refinitiv/Thomson Reuters SDC database (domestic and cross-border deals for the 61 board-reform countries), excluding deals where the bidder or target is a government agency, joint venture, or mutual fund and where the acquisition form is buyback, exchange offer, or recapitalization, and removing financial targets (SIC codes 6000-6999)
context.sample_size: 607,293 deals (main-analysis N varies by dependent variable, e.g. 48,755 acquirer-CAR observations; 11,695 target-CAR observations)

data_sources.name: Board reform list (Fauver et al. 2017 plus manually identified additional major reforms)
